page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge generally falls into the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU tests via stress-ng and Geekbench rank in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in large-block, uncached memory read and write bandwidth, as well as in Passmark CPU extended instructions. Cryptographic operations, database tasks, and Redis SET operations show weaker throughput, while LLM inference speeds for small 135M models achieve average marks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio provide predictable resource availability without the overhead of high-end modern architectures. Given the lack of local storage and modest network bandwidth, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as basic web serving, lightweight application hosting, small-scale development environments, and moderate computational tasks that do not require high-speed local disk I/O or advanced vector processing.
